concepts.label: Vector Query via GSI (Query Service), run through the SDK
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused-leaning - the page states explicitly 'From the SDK, a vector query using GSI is the same as any other query' and shows the query wrapped in `cluster.query(...)`. This is fundamentally the same underlying SQL++ SELECT statement/operation server/ and cloud/ document, just called through `Cluster.query()`. No SDK-specific query semantics are introduced. See cross_product_finding for the concept-id caveat: the registry's n1ql:* ids given to me are all DDL statement ids (create-index, drop-index, etc.); there is no established n1ql:* id for a generic SELECT/vector-SELECT, so I minted a new id in the n1ql namespace rather than force-fitting an unrelated DDL id or minting an sdk:-prefixed duplicate.

cross_product_finding: This single page contains BOTH halves of the batch's central question, cleanly split by which server-side service answers the query: (1) 'Vector Search With the Query Service and GSI' is explicitly described as indistinguishable from any other SQL++ query from the SDK's point of view ('a vector query using GSI is the same as any other query') - I treated this as a reuse case and minted n1ql:vector-query-via-gsi rather than an sdk:-prefixed concept, since the SDK adds no semantics of its own here, it just carries the SELECT statement text through `cluster.query()`. (2) 'Vector Search With the Search Service' is NOT SQL++ at all - it's the SDK's `VectorSearch`/`VectorQuery` builder API against the Search service's own index/query model, so that half is correctly SDK-specific (sdk:vector-search-with-search-service, sdk:vector-query-prefilter). A page can legitimately need concepts from both families depending on which section is being described - I did not force a single answer for the whole page. Caveat on the n1ql:vector-query-via-gsi id: the provided registry only lists DDL statement ids (create-index, drop-index, etc.) as established n1ql:* concepts; there is no confirmed n1ql: id for a generic SELECT or for CREATE VECTOR INDEX's query-time counterpart, so this id is a plausible-but-unconfirmed mint that the coordinator should check against server/'s SELECT-statement concept (if one exists) before treating it as fully reused.
notable_absence: The version gates in this page (8.0.0 for GSI vector query, 7.6.0/7.6.2/7.6.4 for various Search-service vector features) mostly could not be matched to confirmed version:* registry ids (only server-6-5 and server-7-0 concept files were visible), so several relations above approximate with server-7-0 or flag the gap rather than mint speculative version concepts.
